meta.purpose: Deterministic phrase->token normalization. Applied to leftover unmapped prose after extract_observation, before to_vision_payload. Promotes human-verified surface phrasings to closed-vocab tokens the extractor correctly refuses to guess. Verifier owns every entry.
meta.match_semantics: case-insensitive substring. Promotes iff (feature in applies_to_features) AND (any match_any is a substring) AND (no must_not_match is a substring). Guard biased to OVER-BLOCK (stay silent) over over-promote (invent). No numeric threshold.

entries.notes: Cheiro p139: 'When the line of life sweeps far out into the hand, thus allowing the Mount of Venus a greater scope'. sweeping_wide = the wide-sweep case. Bare 'curved'/'slight' stay unmapped. EXCLUDED 'curves around base of thumb' (v1.0.1): anatomy-neutral, not evidence of a wide sweep per Cheiro p139 'sweeps far out into the hand'; promoting it would over-reach an ambiguous observation.
